locus: 9 November, Pro Sancto Theodoro Martyre: Secret printed p.752/PDF866; Postcommunion p.752-753/PDF866-867; two normalized prayer blocks with their actual short conclusion cues.
rights_basis: Bounded historical Latin from the separately registered public-domain Tours Mame 1922 printing. This derivative contains only the two own Theodore orations read on its page images, with their actual short conclusions; it adds no modern source wording and makes no new rights decision. The parent artifact records the United States publication and mechanical-reproduction basis.
text:
Suscipe, Domine, fidelium preces cum oblationibus hostiarum: et, intercedente
beato Theodoro Martyre tuo, per haec piae devotionis officia ad caelestem
gloriam transeamus. Per Dominum.

Praesta nobis, quaesumus, Domine: intercedente beato Theodoro Martyre tuo; ut,
quod ore contingimus, pura mente capiamus. Per Dominum.
